WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ProductKey,
    sum(SalesAmount) AS revenue
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),
with_cum AS (
  SELECT
    ProductKey,
    revenue,
    sum(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_rev,
    sum(revenue) OVER () AS total_rev
  FROM ranked
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    ProductKey,
    CASE
      WHEN (cum_rev - revenue) / nullif(total_rev, 0) < 0.80 THEN 'A'
      WHEN (cum_rev - revenue) / nullif(total_rev, 0) < 0.95 THEN 'B'
      ELSE 'C'
    END AS abc_class
  FROM with_cum
)
SELECT
  abc_class,
  count(*) AS product_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class;
